result.instructions: Tools for absence.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is absent from our team this week?"; "List the absences that are waiting for approval."; "Show the absences of one employee for the last three months.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes absence.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run absenceio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run absenceio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run absenceio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. absenceio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: absenceio_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absence records (leave, sickness and other absences) with paging and an optional filter. absence.io API: POST /api/v2/absences.

filter.description: Filter object in the absence.io query format, for example {"name": "like john"}.

tools.name: absenceio_get_absence
tools.title: Get absence
tools.description: Get one absence record by its id. absence.io API: GET /api/v2/absences/{id}.

tools.name: absenceio_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (employees) in the absence.io account, with paging and an optional filter. absence.io API: POST /api/v2/users.

filter.description: Filter object in the absence.io query format, for example {"name": "like john"}.

tools.name: absenceio_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user (employee) by its id. absence.io API: GET /api/v2/users/{id}.
